name: ui-walkthrough
description: UI 设计走查工具：设计稿与开发截图对比、标注、复验与报告导出
author: quweijia

scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:intel: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:all: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
